completion_data.completion_summary: Modernised FormalSystem/Metalogic/Algebraic/: the BooleanStructure *_quot lemmas are discharged by propDecide (metric 286 -> 105, D2 accept bar), fold_le_of_derives is stated over Multiset.inf, a Mathlib-shaped Order.PFilter proper/maximal/prime-filter layer landed under FormalSystem/ForMathlib/ (including the PrimeSeparator corollary), and UltrafilterMCS.lean was ported onto Order.PrimeFilter LindenbaumAlg with SetMaximalConsistent.ultrafilterEquiv at the corrected type and the bespoke Ultrafilter structure deleted (1071 -> 801 lines). lake build and all module invariants green; C2 axiom baseline unchanged.

memory_candidates.content: propDecide only matches a goal that is syntactically `Derivable …`; on the Lindenbaum quotient order the pattern is `induction a using Quotient.ind with | _ φ =>` then `change Derives …; unfold Derives; propDecide`. Hypothesis-driven lattice laws: state the conditional as a closed tautology (e.g. `((φ.imp χ).and (ψ.imp χ)).imp ((φ.or ψ).imp χ)`), close it with propDecide, and discharge with Combinators.pairing + DerivationTree.modus_ponens.

Mathlib-native encoding of Boolean-algebra ultrafilters: `Order.PrimeFilter P := {F : Order.PFilter P // F.IsPrime}` with the IsProper/IsMaximal API in FormalSystem/ForMathlib/Order/PFilter.lean. Mathlib's own `Ultrafilter α` is a filter on `Set α`, never the right target. Deleting a bespoke `Ultrafilter` structure silently retargets any surviving `Ultrafilter X` spelling to Mathlib's — retype every binder.

`Order.PFilter.mem_of_le` takes `x ≤ y` before `x ∈ F` (opposite of a hand-rolled `mem_of_le : a ∈ F → a ≤ b → b ∈ F`); `Multiset.inf` over `(↑(L.map f) : Multiset _)` steps by `simp only [List.map_cons, ← Multiset.cons_coe, Multiset.inf_cons]` and `[List.map_nil, Multiset.coe_nil, Multiset.inf_zero]`.

reflection.what_worked: Trialling every proof shape in a standalone lean_run_code snippet against the built oleans before touching a file meant every one of the 32 commits built green on the first attempt; the research spike's appendices transcribed unchanged.
reflection.what_was_hard: The plan's finer commit split for Phase 6 assumed old and new `mcsToUltrafilter` could coexist; they cannot under one name, so the type change had to land as one connected commit. Also the acceptance-criterion-1 command counts each lemma's trailing blank line, which is what keeps the figure at 105 rather than 90.
reflection.what_was_missed: Nothing in scope; the optional non-tracked project-overview courtesy edit was skipped on a rule conflict.
